boundary_basis.statement: No official precise redline exists in the public site package. Every area and ratio below is computed from the provisional rough boundary and is a provisional measure only. These values must not be used as a statutory area basis, nor for approval, tendering, or investment decisions.
boundary_basis.planar_approximation: M_PER_DEG_LAT=110540; M_PER_DEG_LON=111320*cos(39.98275). One documented constant pair is used for every derived area and length in this package.
boundary_basis.recalculation_interface: Replace geometry/site_boundary.geojson with the official geometry and re-run the recalculation; all derived metrics update without any change to the proposal text.

metric_families.spatial: Derived from the nine GeoJSON layers with a single documented planar approximation.
metric_families.blocked: Deliberately left unknown because the public site package does not contain the statutory input.
metric_families.harness: Derived from the offline deterministic replay recorded in simulation.json.

assumptions: Computed from the provisional rough boundary registered in the site package; official_boundary=false and geometry_role=provisional_constraint.
Planar approximation uses M_PER_DEG_LAT=110540 and M_PER_DEG_LON=111320*cos(39.98275); the same constants are used for every derived area in this package.
Not a statutory or precise area basis; usable only to explain method and relative relationships.
Sums the 26 schematic key volumes proposed by the scheme; this is not a survey of the existing building stock, so the value is far below a real built-up figure.
Indicates order of magnitude and relative placement only.
Sums the 14 mutually exclusive features of the green-system layer.
Green features never sit inside a non-green land-use zone, so no area is counted twice.
Sums the 16 mutually exclusive public rooms of the public-space system layer.
Public rooms nest inside the park spine or the blocks; the ratio is summed once from this layer only.
The denominator is the provisional site area, so the ratio inherits its provisional status.
Expresses structural intent about the park-led green frame; it is not evidence of compliance with any green-line requirement.
The denominator is the provisional site area, so the ratio inherits its provisional status.
Used to compare the public-space orientation of alternatives, never as a control indicator.
v4.7 起用地层是对临时设计边界的完整、无重叠剖分：全部分区裁剪至边界内，剩余范围由留白用地（代码 16）闭合，因此覆盖率按定义为 1.0。
v4.6 及以前的 0.690497 把外溢到设计边界之外的分区面积计入分子，属口径错误，已在 v4.7 更正。
其中主动策划分区占 63.09%，留白用地占 36.91%；分区是用地单元而非可出让地块。
Sums the 20 concept alignments of the slow-mobility and connection network.
An alignment expresses a network relationship; it is never a road redline or an engineering centreline.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and the official site boundary are both absent from the public site package. The scheme deliberately makes no estimate, because a floor area ratio conclusion would exceed the responsibility boundary declared for machine-agent submissions.

building_height_limit_m.reason: No approved height control is published for the belt. The scheme states a height and massing intent in words and refuses to publish a numeric limit that a reader could mistake for a statutory control.

resident_population.reason: No population figure for the belt extent exists in the public site package, and inferring one from open sources would create a false precision about real residents.

parking_supply_spaces.reason: Parking supply is a control-detailed-planning output. At urban-design concept stage the scheme sets a parking policy direction in words instead of a number.

assumptions: The three key areas required by the taskbook are represented by provisional polygons pending the official release.
Counts the scenarios that carry a full evidence, review and exit description in the proposal.
Counts the scenarios that reach industrial validation in the Dazhongsi cluster.
Counts the numbered renewal projects in the project list.
Six official scenarios multiplied by eight task templates; every record is fixed data, so the count is reproducible offline.

simulation_success_rate.formula: count(outcome == success or outcome endswith _success) / len(tasks)
assumptions: 41 of 48 tasks close successfully; blocked and refused tasks are deliberately not counted as success.
Tasks blocked by a missing official dataset stay blocked, because reporting them as success would hide the data gap.
47 of 48 dispatches validate against the tool schema; the single malformed dispatch is kept in the record rather than removed.
Two heavy replans exceed the per-task budget and are published as violations instead of being averaged away.
All 48 tasks emit a complete audit record, including the blocked and refused ones.
13 of 13 flagged tasks are intercepted before any action is taken.
Interception means the task stops and waits for a human reviewer; it never means the task silently continues.
Nearest-rank p95 at position 46 of 48 sorted values, so a reviewer can recompute it by counting.
